description: Welcome back guys! Aaj ki video mein main aapko dikhane wala hoon ek bilkul NAYA aur Insane Itachi Uchiha (Naruto) themed UI/Client pack for Minecraft PE / Bedrock Edition! Agar aap Naruto anime aur Itachi ke fan hain, toh ye red and black Sharingan theme wala texture pack aapko bohot pasand aayega. Isme custom Main Menu, Loading Screen, Hotbar, aur Inventory milti hai!
